title: One device is rare; a fleet is routine
caption: Probability of at least one silent-corruption event per hour, computed from the fleet formula at residual rate p = 10^-4 per device-hour. At 10,000 devices the fleet expects an event in more than half of all hours: per-device reliability becomes a coordination cost.

title: A same-recipe test set costs every model
caption: Reported accuracy drop on ImageNet-V2 across 212 models scoring at least 55 percent on the original validation set: every model loses 7 to 14 points, median 12, and the loss tracks accuracy nearly linearly. Held-out accuracy is an optimistic estimate of the next population, not a prediction of it.
yLabel: accuracy points below the original validation set
